candidates.risks: topic/arXiv-category family already covered (8 other archive groups); physics.* archive itself unused. Cross-lists; skewed toward optics. Must exclude papers also cross-listed into OHS-1/OHS-2 archives if strictness wanted.

candidates.name: Stack Exchange: which site was this question posted on
candidates.labels: choose 30-60 of 184 main sites that have >=40 questions since 2026-06-01 (e.g. cooking, bicycles, travel, law, gardening, superuser, ...)
candidates.label_defs: official: each site's 'audience' string from /2.3/sites (e.g. Arqade: 'passionate videogamers on all platforms')
candidates.size: low-traffic sites have ~50 Qs since June (gardening 48); big sites 100s-1000s
candidates.verified: fetched questions from cooking, superuser, gardening, bicycles, law, travel; /sites returned 184 main sites; unauth quota 300/day (≈290 left)
candidates.risks: overlapping sites (superuser/askubuntu/unix; math/mathoverflow) need pruning; site-specific tags must be stripped; some 2026 posts are LLM-assisted; law site post had content_license None -> drop such posts

candidates.name: Stack Exchange close reason
candidates.labels: Duplicate, Needs details or clarity, Needs more focus, Opinion-based, Not suitable for this site
candidates.label_defs: official: Stack Exchange Help Center 'What if my question is closed?' close-reason texts
candidates.size: dozens-hundreds per site since June (superuser 5 of 5 recent closed fetched)
candidates.verified: fetched superuser closed questions (Not suitable x4, Duplicate x1)
candidates.risks: 'Duplicate' not decidable without the original (drop or treat as yes/no); 'Not suitable' depends on each site's scope (include site scope in state); closure is moderator judgement -> label noise

candidates.name: GitHub issue maintainer label (bug / feature / docs / question)
candidates.access: api.github.com/repos/<owner>/<repo>/issues?state=all&since=2026-06-01 on a frozen list of established repos with maintainer triage labels (e.g. microsoft/vscode 'bug'/'feature-request'); unauth 60 req/h

candidates.labels: bug, enhancement/feature-request, documentation, question (map per repo)
candidates.label_defs: official: GitHub default label descriptions ('Something isn't working', 'New feature or request', 'Improvements or additions to documentation', 'Further information is requested')
candidates.size: search API: 1.84M issues labelled bug created after 2026-06-01
candidates.verified: search/issues label:bug created:>2026-06-01 returned items; vscode closed issues since Jul with ['bug', ...] labels fetched
candidates.risks: per-repo label conventions differ; issue titles often prefixed 'fix:'/'feat:' (leak -> strip); many new-repo issues are LLM/bot-written (use only established repos); licence of issue text unclear
